# Question 1

```{r}
imdb_dataset =read_csv("IMDB Dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

imdb_dataset$review[2]
```

# Question 2
View code in .Rmd file
```{r}
# a- Replace the line breaks from the reviews
imdb_dataset$review <- str_replace_all(imdb_dataset$review, "<br /><br />", "")
```

```{r}
# b- Replace “.” with a “. ”
imdb_dataset <- imdb_dataset %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(review=str_replace_all(review, fixed("."), fixed(". ")))
```

```{r}
# c- Remove all the special characters
imdb_dataset$review<-str_to_lower(imdb_dataset$review)

imdb_dataset$review<-str_remove_all(imdb_dataset$review, pattern = "[`~!@#$%^&*()|'-_+\"{}\\[\\]><?/:,;\\.]")

```

```{r}
# d- Remove any extra spaces in the reviews 
imdb_dataset$review<-str_trim(imdb_dataset$review, side = c("both"))
```

```{r}
# e- Remove all numbers
imdb_dataset$review<-str_remove_all(imdb_dataset$review, pattern = "\\d+")
```


# Question 3
```{r}
movie_reviews_words<-imdb_dataset %>% 
  unnest_tokens(word,review) %>%
  filter(nchar(word)>=3) %>%
  select("word")

movie_reviews_words
```

# Question 4
```{r}
movie_reviews_words<-
  anti_join(movie_reviews_words,stop_words, by = c("word" = "word"))

movie_reviews_words
```

# Question 5
```{r}
movie_reviews_words %>%
  count(word, sort=TRUE, name="word_frequency")
```

# Question 6
```{r}
movie_reviews_words %>%
  count(word, sort=TRUE, name="word_frequency") %>%
  mutate(rank=dense_rank(desc(word)))
```
# Question 7

```{r}
df<-movie_reviews_words %>%
  count(word, sort=TRUE, name="word_frequency") 
  
ggplot(df[1:25,], aes(y=reorder(word, word_frequency), x=word_frequency))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill="blue")+
  labs(x="Word_Freqquency", y="Word")
```

# Question 8
```{r}
wordcloud(df[0:100,]$word, 
          df[0:100,]$word_frequency)

```

# Question 9
```{r}
wordcloud2(df[1:100,])
```
